# Klinik Hijraa 24 Jam Dungun

> A 24-hour medical clinic in Kuala Dungun, Terengganu, Malaysia. The 4th branch of Hijraa Group, operating since 5 May 2022. Rated 4.9★ from 1,100+ Google reviews. Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, including public holidays — walk-ins welcome, no appointment needed.

## Key facts
- Name: Klinik Hijraa 24 Jam Dungun (also known as Klinik Hijraa Dungun, Klinik 24 Jam Dungun)
- Address: 2785 & 2786, Tingkat Bawah (Ground Floor), Batu 48, Jalan Paka, 23000 Kuala Dungun, Terengganu, Malaysia
- Phone & WhatsApp: 013-9237548 (+60 13 923 7548)
- Email: hijraadungunhealthcare@gmail.com
- Hours: Open 24 hours, every day (Monday–Sunday), including public holidays
- Languages: Bahasa Melayu, English
- Areas served: Dungun, Paka, and surrounding areas in Terengganu

## Services
- 24-hour emergency and general medical care
- X-Ray, ultrasound, and ECG (on-site diagnostics)
- Nebuliser and IV drip
- Wound cleaning and dressing
- Circumcision (khatan)
- Minor surgery
- Vaccination and immunisation
- Health screening and allergy testing
- Ear cleaning
- Family planning
- Neonatal jaundice screening
- House calls (home treatment): doctor examination, IV drip, wound care, catheter insertion/changing
- Men's and women's health services

## Insurance & panels accepted (30+)
PM Care, TNB, MiCare, e-MAS, Etiqa, HealthConnect, UiTM, PERKESO HSP, PEKA B40, MARA, MedKad, IHP Healthcare, Health Metrics, MedNefits, Medilink Global, Perodua, KeTengah, Maidam, NIOSH, MMC Corporation, Compumed, Swift, WeCare, ASP Medical, Arkema, Red Alert, SATU, Sushi King, TFC, and more.
